text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [All Turns] When any of your [ME] trait Digimon would leave the battle area other than by your effects, 1 of them and any of your other Digimon may DNA digivolve into an [ME] trait Digimon card in the hand.

qa.answer: No. You can’t ignore the digivolution requirements, so you can’t DNA digivolve into a Digimon card that doesn’t have [DNA Digivolve].
qa.question: With this card's inherited effect, can I DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in my hand that doesn’t have [DNA Digivolve]?

qa.answer: No. You can’t ignore the digivolution requirements, so you can’t DNA digivolve using a Digimon that isn’t specified in [DNA Digivolution].
qa.question: Using this card's inherited effect, can I DNA digivolve into a card in the hand that isn't the Digimon specified in [DNA Digivolve]?

qa.answer:
It refers to any Digimon that is not the [ME] trait Digimon leaving the battle area.
This card's inherited effect triggers when any of your [ME] trait Digimon would leave the battle area.
When activated, one [ME] trait Digimon that would leave the battle area and one of your other Digimon DNA Digivolve.
qa.question: In this card's inherited effect, which Digimon does "other Digimon" refer to?

qa.answer:
No, it doesn't leave the battle area.
DNA digivolution digivolves it into a new Digimon that is different from the one that would leave the battle area.
qa.question: If I use this card's inherited effect to DNA digivolve using two Digimon including one that would leave the battle area, does the DNA digivolved Digimon leave the battle area?
